description: This file contains the WorkShiftService class, a service component that manages operations related to work shifts in the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It provides methods for retrieving default shift times, fetching specific shifts by ID, and obtaining lists and counts of work shifts based on search filters.

classes.name: WorkShiftService
classes.description: A service class managing work shift operations such as retrieving default times, specific shifts, and lists based on filters.

methods.name: getWorkShiftDefaultStartAndEndTime
methods.description: Returns the default start and end times for work shifts as a WorkShiftStartAndEndTime object.

methods.name: getWorkShiftById
methods.description: Fetches a WorkShift entity by its ID.

methods.name: getWorkShiftDao
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns the WorkShiftDao instance.

methods.name: setWorkShiftDao
methods.description: Sets the WorkShiftDao dependency for the service.

methods.name: getWorkShiftList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of work shifts based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getWorkShiftCount
methods.description: Returns the count of work shifts matching the search filter parameters.
